scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ensemble/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web "npm run dev -w @ensemble/shared" "npm run dev -w @ensemble/server" "npm run dev -w @ensemble/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ensemble/shared && npm run build -w @ensemble/server && npm run build -w @ensemble/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ensemble/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @ensemble/shared && npm run db:migrate -w @ensemble/server
